about: Sessions of two earlier runs of the pedagogy evaluation, each turn as the examples judge reads it (meaning.visible), and hand-written sessions (synthetic: true) for failures those runs did not show. Every turn is labelled by hand: its examples change the meaning of what they stand for (changes), keep it (keeps), there is none (none), or the words allow both readings (ambiguous, not scored). must marks a turn the judge has to get right. Every student line is scripted: no child's words. It is development data: the judge's prompt was written with these runs at hand, so passing on it shows fit, not that the judge generalizes.
